policy: Search within 10 miles of Shawlands based on the actual home ground or regular training base of the specific team. Do not infer a team's base from a club's postal address or unrelated venue. Keep unknown distances provisional. Include senior men's teams at ALL league levels, with no WOSFL division restriction; U18/U20/U21/reserve/development teams; professional academies; grassroots youth clubs; and relevant local private football coaching employers. Treat social handles as verified only where linked by official club or trusted local authority directory. Exclude women's and girls' football teams, programmes, vacancies and recruitment posts. Monitor men's and boys' football only.

reference_policy: Only list links that directly relate to the named club or academy. Generic league pages and unrelated club directories are not club references. If no direct source has been verified, leave sources empty and mark the entry provisional.
discovery_policy: Daily workflow scans public grassroots club directories and league membership listings for new men's and boys' football organisations. New names are added to a separate candidate queue for location and scope screening; only organisations with a relevant team and home/training base verified within 10 miles of Shawlands are promoted to this directory. Women's and girls' football excluded.

distance_check.method: Straight-line distance from Shawlands Cross to the geocoded training venue; home ground is used only as a clearly labelled proxy where no precise training venue is recorded.
